maximum_scenario: Maintained preindustrial crop system with additional clearing and low-lift surface irrigation; current crop/rotation held fixed. No modern fertilizer, powered pumping or unlimited basin supply.
normalization: Game multiplier is the local reference support density bounded to 0.25–5. Base and improvement effective units are inversely normalized to preserve every capacity contribution. These are game-design bounds, not historical yield limits.

dry_field_alternatives.status: Inferred local adoption of an existing regionally documented crop on reconstructed cultivated land where the representative crop has zero rainfed yield and no water service. Does not enlarge cultivated land or apply to uncultivated frontiers. Regional availability, not proof of each cell's crop. Test 0 and 0.5 shares separately.
dry_field_alternatives.source: Existing configs/regions.json historical crop availability and preference; GAEZ crop rasters with existing historical transformations. Independent Great Lakes check: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11335020/ (2024, CC BY 4.0); directly dated finger millet and sorghum before 1300, not a local field-share estimate.

assumption_status: First-iteration shared land-access and water-demand priors, not measured medieval fractions. PNV controls vegetation barriers; existing cultivation is retained as dated evidence. Refine without using population as predictor.
noncrop_rule: Existing FORGE terrestrial baseline on all land, with pastoral food-system estimates where assigned. Clearing displaces existing support. Aquatic food excluded and explicitly labelled.

zero_support_completion.status: Explicit low-confidence same-livelihood/ecoregion/climate analogue for wholly unsupported ownable locations. Uses existing terrestrial support, not fish or population. Lower donor decile excluded as near-zero interpolation tails; replacement is lower quartile of eight environmental neighbours.

terrain_access.status: GAEZ class boundaries; conservative shared access weights inferred. ETOPO 60s smooths subpixel slopes; no new terraces assumed.
